description: Get the organization's AI switches: models_enabled (AI features) and automatic_send_enabled (automations may send AI-drafted replies without review), plus effective, which says whether each is in effect now. Shipmail can hold either off for every organization.
name: shipmail_get_organization_ai_settings

automatic_send_enabled.description: The organization's own switch for automations sending AI-drafted replies.

effective.description: Whether each switch is in effect. Shipmail can hold either off for everyone.

models_enabled.description: The organization's own switch for AI features.

title: Get Organization AI Settings
